allow_empty_filter.description: Allow using an empty filter. May also be provided via `NETBOX_LISTS_ALLOW_EMPTY_FILTER` environment variable. Defaults to `false`.

lists_path.description: Path to the NetBox Lists plugin to be appended to `url`. May also be provided via `NETBOX_LISTS_PATH` environment variable. Defaults to `/api/plugins/lists`.

request_timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. May also be provided via `NETBOX_LISTS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` environment variable. Defaults to `10`.

token.description: NetBox token. May also be provided via `NETBOX_TOKEN` environment variable.

url.description: NetBox URL. May also be provided via `NETBOX_URL` environment variable.

block.description:
A Terraform provider to interact with the
[NetBox Lists](https://github.com/devon-mar/netbox-lists) plugin for NetBox.

as_cidr.description: Convenience attribute for setting the `as_cidr` parameter. Equivalent to `filter={as_cidr=true/false}`.

family.description: Convenience attribute for setting the `family` parameter. Equivalent to `filter={family=4/6}`.

list4.description: List of IPv4 addresses/prefixes if `split_af` is `true`.

list6.description: List of IPv4 addresses/prefixes if `split_af` is `true`.

list_no_cidr.description: List of IP addresses/prefixes with prefix length removed for single IPs if `no_cidr_single_ip` is `true`.

max.description: Throw an error if the number of IPs/prefixes is greater than `max`.

min.description: Throw an error if the number of IPs/prefixes is less than `min`.

no_cidr_single_ip.description: Populates `list_no_cidr` with elements from `list` but removes `/32` and `/128` from single IPs. Useful for resources whose idempotency breaks when single IPs are in CIDR format.

split_af.description: Populate `list4` and `list6` with the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from `list`.

summarize.description: Convenience attribute for setting the `summarize` parameter. Equivalent to `filter={summarize=true/false}`.
